AI Engineer — Applied LLM Platform
Aperture AI · Remote (EU) · Full-time

About the role
We're building the platform that lets our product teams ship LLM-powered
features safely. You'll design retrieval pipelines, evaluation harnesses, and the
services that put models into production.

What you'll do
- Build and operate Python backend services that serve LLM features to production traffic.
- Design RAG pipelines: chunking, embeddings, vector search, and reranking.
- Stand up evaluation harnesses (offline eval sets, LLM-as-judge) to measure quality.
- Add observability and cost tracking to LLM calls (tracing, dashboards).
- Work with cloud infra and CI/CD to deploy services reliably.

Must-have
- 3+ years of professional software engineering, primarily in Python.
- Experience building and operating web services / APIs in production.
- Solid grasp of PostgreSQL or a comparable relational database.
- Comfortable with Docker and CI/CD pipelines.

Nice-to-have
- Hands-on experience with LLM APIs, embeddings, or vector databases (pgvector, Pinecone).
- Familiarity with RAG, prompt engineering, or model evaluation.
- Experience with observability tooling (OpenTelemetry, Langfuse, Datadog).
- Kubernetes experience.
